purpose: Regression cases for the propagation rule: one term producing several labels, two terms collapsing into the same pair, and a term with no vocabulary ancestor before the binding extension.

examples.demonstrates: binding extension: identical protein binding contributes binding; two channel terms collapse into transporter activity
dedup: two distinct NAD+ synthase terms yield the same {catalytic activity, ligase activity} pair; ATP binding yields binding
one term producing three labels (topoisomerase -> catalytic activity, isomerase activity, catalytic activity acting on DNA); DNA binding also yields binding
